title: SmartAgri Researcher Continues Doctoral Research at Ehime University

body:
Saifuddin Afif, researcher at the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) of Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), is continuing his research at Ehime University, Ehime Prefecture, Japan, to pursue doctoral studies. His research will examine the use of signals or information from plants to regulate cultivation environments. This study links plant responses with the control of growing conditions.

Afif's doctoral research is being conducted under the SUIJI Joint Program (SUIJI-JP), a collaboration between six universities in Japan and Indonesia. These six universities are Ehime University, Kagawa University, Kochi University, UGM, IPB University, and Universitas Hasanuddin (Unhas). The program encompasses master's and doctoral levels, as well as learning and research guidance at partner universities.

During his research in Japan, Afif will join the environmental control laboratory at Ehime University. This field studies the regulation of environmental conditions to support plant growth. He will deepen his understanding of how to use information from plants to regulate conditions in a growth chamber, which is a growing space with controlled environment, and in a plant factory, a facility for plant production in an enclosed space.

Afif's research period is estimated to last approximately one year. The research topic will be discussed with professors at Ehime University based on offered themes. Study activities also include research and plans for joint publications.

Afif hopes that this study and research experience will broaden his knowledge. Upon returning to Indonesia, he hopes that this knowledge will provide benefits and support his efforts to contribute to Indonesia's development. His research is expected to strengthen understanding of the application of plant signals in controlled cultivation.

## Connection with the SDGs

-   SDG 2 – Zero Hunger. Afif's research will examine the use of plant information to regulate cultivation conditions. This study relates to the development of methods that can support the management of agricultural production. This connection stems from the focus of the research and does not yet demonstrate measurable production impacts.

-   SDG 9 – Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure. This study links the analysis of plant signals with environmental regulation in growth chambers and plant factories. This focus relates to the development of technological approaches for controlled cultivation. The impact of its application cannot be assessed before the research is carried out.

original.body:
Saifuddin Afif, peneliti Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), melanjutkan penelitian di Ehime University, Prefektur Ehime, Jepang, untuk menempuh studi doktoral. Penelitiannya akan membahas pemanfaatan sinyal atau informasi dari tanaman untuk mengatur lingkungan budidaya. Kajian ini menghubungkan respons tanaman dengan pengendalian kondisi tumbuh.

Penelitian doktoral Afif berlangsung dalam kerangka SUIJI Joint Program (SUIJI-JP), kolaborasi enam universitas di Jepang dan Indonesia. Keenam universitas itu ialah Ehime University, Kagawa University, Kochi University, UGM, IPB University, dan Universitas Hasanuddin (Unhas). Program ini mencakup jenjang magister dan doktoral, serta pembelajaran dan bimbingan penelitian di universitas mitra.

Selama penelitian di Jepang, Afif akan bergabung dengan laboratorium _environmental control_ di Ehime University. Bidang ini mempelajari pengaturan kondisi lingkungan untuk mendukung pertumbuhan tanaman. Ia akan mendalami cara menggunakan informasi dari tanaman untuk mengatur kondisi di _growth chamber_, yaitu ruang tumbuh dengan lingkungan terkendali, dan _plant factory_ fasilitas produksi tanaman di dalam ruang.

Masa penelitian Afif diperkirakan berlangsung sekitar satu tahun. Topik penelitian akan dibahas bersama profesor di Ehime University berdasarkan tema yang ditawarkan. Kegiatan studi juga mencakup penelitian dan rencana publikasi bersama.

Afif berharap pengalaman studi dan riset itu dapat memperluas pengetahuannya. Setelah kembali ke Indonesia, ia berharap pengetahuan tersebut dapat memberi manfaat dan mendukung upayanya berkontribusi bagi pembangunan Indonesia. Risetnya diharapkan memperkuat pemahaman tentang pemanfaatan sinyal tanaman dalam budidaya terkontrol.

## Keterkaitan dengan SDGs

-   SDG 2 – Tanpa Kelaparan. Penelitian Afif akan mengkaji penggunaan informasi tanaman untuk mengatur kondisi budidaya. Kajian ini berkaitan dengan pengembangan metode yang dapat mendukung pengelolaan produksi pertanian. Keterkaitan ini berangkat dari fokus riset dan belum menunjukkan dampak produksi yang terukur.

-   SDG 9 – Industri, Inovasi, dan Infrastruktur. Studi ini menghubungkan analisis sinyal tanaman dengan pengaturan lingkungan di _growth chamber_ dan _plant factory_. Fokus tersebut berkaitan dengan pengembangan pendekatan teknologi untuk budidaya terkontrol. Dampak penerapannya belum dapat dinilai sebelum penelitian terlaksana.
